description: EA-63 (11e 09.07 / 09.02.02): TACTICAL FLUIDITY's fall-back at the end of the OPPONENT's Fight phase follows the fall-back modes. Fixture sm11e_m3a_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2), the Fight-phase flow of sm11e_tactical_withdrawal. Setup privileges: the WP-M3a detachments, the Ork player 0 CP, the shipped Captain in Phobos Armour (armies/sm11e_codex_test.json) set up 1.9" south of the Kommandos (engaged, not battle-shocked), every engaged unit counts as having fought, Codex: Space Marines datasheet-ability cards on (sm_abilities_b). Real clicks: End Pile-in, End Fight, End Consolidation; the fight_phase_end window offers the Tactical Fluidity card with TWO options — Ordered Retreat / Desperate Escape — and no plain Use; a click on Desperate Escape makes the Captain's hazard roll, the fall-back (up to 6" away from the Kommandos, ending unengaged) and then the 09.07 battle-shock roll, all in the game log. Before the fix: one plain Use, no hazard roll, no battle-shock roll.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the seven WP-M3a detachments, the Ork player 0 CP
setup privilege: the shipped Captain in Phobos Armour, 1.9" south of the Kommandos' front model (engaged with them only)
a window not under test (if any) is declined
the other player's pile-in half (if offered)
setup privilege: every engaged unit counts as having fought (the fights themselves are not under test)
the other player's consolidation half (if offered)
no plain Use: the 09.07 fall-back mode is one of the card's two options
REAL click on the card's Desperate Escape option
a re-offered window (if any) is declined
the fall-back was made as a desperate escape
BEFORE MOVING: one hazard roll for the Captain's model
AFTER MOVING: the battle-shock roll (the Captain was not battle-shocked)
the Captain fell back away from the Kommandos and ends unengaged
